g.text: Ultra-Luxurious Real Estate Asset Management & Development ERP

text.tspan: Complete property lifecycle, native 22 Yemeni governorates land calculation (لبنة صنعانية، قصبة، معاد),
legal brokerage engine (2.5% سعاية شرعية), multi-branch lease/sale escrow, tri-currency treasury (USD/YER/SAR),
and A4 print vouchers with 100% strict Arabic RTL luxury aesthetic.

g.text: Automotive Showroom, Fleet Management & Daily Rental ERP

text.tspan: Vehicle inventory management, daily/monthly rental contracts with mandatory collateral,
custom Yemeni governorate license plate generator (1-22), car preparation expense ledger,
HWID hardware-bound licensing, and automated bilingual invoices.

g.text: Enterprise IT Asset Management & Campus Incident ERP

text.tspan: Hardware lifecycle registry, interactive 6x4 lab station blueprint grid, service desk & Kanban
incident ticketing, custodial asset transfers between staff, software licenses expiry tracking,
and immutable tamper-proof system audit logging.

g.text: Conversational Customer Agent & Enterprise Knowledge Retrieval

text.tspan: End-to-end automated customer service via WhatsApp Business Cloud API, vector database search
over private corporate documents, and autonomous lead routing with multi-turn conversation memory
and dynamic fallback to human escalation.
Real-time webcam barcode decoding with OpenCV and Pyzbar, automated high-precision timestamping,
instant cutoff-time logic (On-Time vs Late marking), direct MySQL database synchronization,
and instant CSV report generation for administration.

g.text: Financial Anomaly Detection in Transaction Networks

metrics, topological node embeddings, and unsupervised anomaly detection on complex multi-tier
